thread:
Alex Chen: heads-up — Ridgewood HackNight confirmed May 12. We need booth schedule, swag order, speaker confirmations, demo rota, and lead-routing. Who can own shipping + speaker coord? cc @Maria Lopez @Jon Patel
Maria Lopez: I can own speaker coord and slide approvals. will sync with speakers this week.
Jon Patel: I can take shipping + swag ops. need final counts and a ship-by date.
Samir Rao: I can do lead-routing & demo signups. planning a Typeform + QR at booth. draft link: https://t.typeform.com/to/abcd1234 (placeholder)
Priya Singh: budget check — how many premium swag vs cheap stickers? also need power + HDMI adapter on-site.
Alex Chen: goal: 800 visitors estimate. propose: 300 stickers, 200 shirts (unisex S-XL), 50 enamel pins, 30 plushies (demo prize). thoughts?
Jon Patel: that breakdown seems fine. can we drop plushies to 15? shipping/weight budget is tight.
Maria Lopez: 15 plushies + 2 demo prize cards = fine. I'll confirm speaker headcount (currently 3 panels + 2 lightning).
Samir Rao: putting together demo rota spreadsheet — please add available times: https://docs.google.com/sheetsexample (edit access)
Alex Chen: @marketing-bot can you create a calendar event for the booth team for May 12-13 and ping volunteers?
marketing-bot: created event "Ridgewood HackNight — Booth Team" May 12 08:00-18:00 with reminders.
Priya Singh: shipping label + warehouse details (for Jon):
```
Redwood Inference — Ridgewood HackNight
c/o Partner Logistics
Dock 4, 125 Harbor Way
Ridgewood Convention Center
Ridgewood, NJ 07001
Contact: Jon Patel +1-555-0123
```
Jon Patel: got it. Ordering swag today. I'll share order confirmation and tracking in this thread.
Maria Lopez: speakers — I need talk titles + 1-slide bio by Friday. I'll compile and send to design for one-sheet.
Samir Rao: lead-routing plan: Typeform collects name, email, company, interest area. Tags: demo, enterprise, partner. I'll set webhook to /marketing/leads and send routing rules: enterprise -> sales-sdr@redwood.com; demo -> growth-team@redwood.com.
Alex Chen: perfect. one final ask: booth banner copy options, short and punchy. Drafts: 1) "Run LLMs predictably — Anywhere." 2) "Ship LLM features, not ops." Vote with :thumbsup: for 1, :raised_hands: for 2.
Priya Singh: :raised_hands: (option 2)
Maria Lopez: :thumbsup: (option 1)
Jon Patel: :raised_hands: (option 2)
Alex Chen: tied — I'll pull designer in for quick mock and we can finalize tomorrow. thanks all — Jon, Maria, Samir = owners. I'll retitle calendar event and add rotation slots.
Samir Rao: noted. I'll also prepare quick demo scripts (30s, 90s) and print one-pagers for the table.
Jon Patel: order placed (vendor: Swagly). ETA to warehouse May 6. will post tracking when available.
Maria Lopez: speaker checklist to follow: slide, bio, talk length, AV checklist.
Alex Chen: closing loop — everyone add any blockers by EOD. otherwise we'll proceed with counts/shipping. :rocket:
